summary: Console (staging) "Model release notes" link returns 404 after docs deploy
description:
Issue summary:
- In Console staging, the "Model release notes" link from the model/version page (Changelog tab) is returning a 404.
- Repro is consistent across multiple models/versions.

Impact:
- Internal only (staging), but blocks QA for the changelog beta UI and end-to-end review workflow (draft -> in_review -> published).
- Risk for GA if the Console uses the same URL construction in prod.

Environment:
- Console: staging
- Docs site: staging
- Feature flag: changelog_ui_enabled=true (internal)

Steps to reproduce:
1) Log into Console staging.
2) Navigate to Models -> any model -> select a version -> open "Changelog" tab.
3) Click "View full release notes".

Expected:
- Opens docs site page for the model version release notes.

Actual:
- Docs site returns 404.
- Example URL generated by Console:
  https://docs.staging.redwoodinference.com/model-release-notes/redwood/llama-3-70b-instruct/versions/2026-02-14

Notes:
- This started after the docs deploy on 2026-02-16 ~18:40 PT (per #docs).
- I can load the docs homepage and other pages; only release notes paths appear broken.

Attachments / evidence:
- Screenshot: Console modal shows the above URL; browser network tab shows 404 (GET)
- Console logs: request_id=stg-7f3c3d1a4e9a, route=model_changelog_link_out

Suspected owner:
- DevEx/docs build pipeline or docs routing config (route rename / missing rewrite).
comments:
2026-02-16 20:11 PT — Leila Farouk (Reporter)
Added one more example:
- 404 also for: https://docs.staging.redwoodinference.com/model-release-notes/redwood/mistral-7b/versions/2026-02-10
This looks like a global route issue rather than model-specific content.

2026-02-16 20:28 PT — Elliot Price (Assignee)
Ack. Checking staging docs deploy history + routing config.
Hypothesis: the docs PR that added release notes moved the base path to /model-release-notes/ (pluralization / trailing slash), and staging is missing the rewrite rule for deep links.
Looping in Wei to confirm the intended canonical path from redwood-docs changes.

2026-02-16 20:44 PT — Wei Chen
Confirmed in redwood-docs PR_982 we introduced "Model release notes" as a generated section and the canonical route is:
- /models/release-notes/{model_id}/{version_id}
We had an internal alias /model-release-notes/... during development, but it was removed as part of nav cleanup.
Staging is currently not serving the alias and also not redirecting.
Console is still generating the old path.

2026-02-16 21:03 PT — Chloe Martin
Thanks. Console backend currently constructs:
  /model-release-notes/{org}/{model_slug}/versions/{version}
from older mocks.
We can patch Console, but for staging QA we’d prefer docs to also redirect for backward compatibility.
What’s the best approach? (redirect vs. rewrite) We also have links already embedded in a few internal docs.

2026-02-17 09:12 PT — Elliot Price
Plan:
1) Add a redirect in docs for legacy paths:
   /model-release-notes/* -> /models/release-notes/* (with mapping for the slug segments)
2) Update Console link generation to the canonical route to avoid relying on redirects.
I’ll handle (1) in docs; Chloe team can take (2) when they pick up the next Console beta polish.

Opened docs patch to add rewrite + a small regression test so we don’t break deep links again.

2026-02-17 14:36 PT — Elliot Price
Fix merged and deployed to docs staging.
Verification:
- Legacy URL now returns 302 -> canonical /models/release-notes/... and resolves 200.
- Confirmed for 2 sample models/versions from ticket.

Remaining action:
- Console should update link construction (non-blocking for staging due to redirect, but should be corrected before GA).

2026-02-18 10:05 PT — Leila Farouk
Re-tested in staging:
- Clicking "View full release notes" now lands on the correct docs page (after redirect).
- No more 404s.
Marking as resolved. Please add a follow-up for Console to switch to the canonical path so we’re not depending on redirects long-term.
